result.summary: Found several visual issues: a clearly broken promo badge on a restaurant card, truncated restaurant names, and a truncated category chip row label.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a green badge reading '-100%' which looks like broken or incorrect discount/promo labeling rather than a meaningful offer.
issues.suggestion: Replace with a valid promo label (e.g. '50% off' or '€0 delivery') or hide the badge when no valid discount applies.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated mid-word in the Fastest near you row, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a responsive ellipsis with full name on tap, or widen the card text area so names are not cut off.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip appears cut off with only a partial pill visible and no full label, which can look unfinished even if the row is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure category chips have consistent padding/end inset and that partially visible chips still show enough of the label, or add a fade/scroll affordance.
